Title: Add UseWindowsService() to Orchestrator.NodeWorker/Program.cs
Description: setup-node-b.ps1 registers Orchestrator.NodeWorker.exe as a Windows service via sc.exe. Without builder.Host.UseWindowsService() in Program.cs, the SCM stop signal arrives as process termination rather than graceful StopApplication. This causes unclean shutdown, incomplete log flush, and potential metrics data loss. Mcp/Program.cs already calls UseWindowsService() correctly.
